variants.bio: Majin is a dark blue hedgehog with blue shoes. His skin is a light purple, as are his gloves, shoe cuffs, and the stripes on his shoes. His face resembles that of a human, and his eyes are completely black. his mouth is also partially black due to shading, and he has a cleft chin
